body: This Statement of Work defines numbered deliverables, schedule, fees, exclusions, revision limits, and change control for one fixed-price or hourly engagement.
sections.heading: Header and parties

body: List each deliverable with a number, title, format, acceptance criteria, and due milestone. Example numbering shown here is illustrative.
sections.heading: Numbered deliverables

body: Work expressly excluded from this SOW. Any excluded item requested later requires a signed change order.
1. Items not listed in Numbered deliverables above.
2. Additional concepts, drafts, or formats beyond those stated.
3. Third-party costs including stock assets, fonts, hosting, licenses, and filing fees.
4. Client-side tasks including content provision, approvals, access, and testing.

sections.heading: Revision limit clause

body: Small requests of 15 minutes or less that do not alter deliverables or schedule are handled once as a courtesy and logged. Repeat or larger requests use the change-order process.
sections.heading: Courtesy rule

body: Either party may request a change using the Change-Order Form. No changed work starts before written approval and fee agreement.

sections.heading: Approval

body: Copy, adjust brackets, and send. Each script says yes to the relationship and quotes the change. All names, dates, and amounts in examples are illustrative.

Script 1 - Out-of-scope request: Thanks for sending this. That item sits outside the current SOW deliverables D1-D3. I can do it as a change order. The added fee is [amount] and it moves [milestone] by [days, illustrative]. Shall I send the change-order form?

Script 2 - Extra revision round: Happy to do another round on [deliverable]. The included rounds are now used. An additional round is [amount] with delivery by [date, illustrative]. Want me to proceed on that basis?

Script 3 - Rush request: I can prioritize this. Rush delivery by [date, illustrative] adds [amount] and pauses [other deliverable] until [date, illustrative]. Confirm and I will lock the revised schedule.
Script 4 - Unfunded milestone: To keep the schedule, I need [milestone payment] cleared before starting [next deliverable]. Once received I will begin the same day and confirm in writing.
Script 5 - Vague brief: I want to get this right. Please confirm [three acceptance points]. I will then record them as the acceptance criteria for [deliverable] so review stays focused.
sections.heading: Say-yes-and-quote scripts

body: Guidance for tone: short, specific, written, with a fee and a date. Avoid long explanations. Keep one request per message. Log every pushback message in the scope register with date sent.
sections.heading: Usage notes

body: Paste this insert into any contract or SOW to set revision boundaries.

Clause text: Each numbered deliverable includes [number, illustrative example uses 2] revision rounds. A revision round means one consolidated set of comments applied within the original acceptance criteria. Requests outside the criteria, new concepts, or new formats are not revisions and require a signed change order. Unused rounds do not carry over. Additional rounds are billed at [rate] per round.
sections.heading: Standalone revision-limit clause

body: How to use the clause: fill the bracketed number and rate, attach the revision counter log, define who consolidates comments, and state turnaround time per round. All bracketed values in this template are illustrative and must be completed before use.
